B210.query:
SELECT 
NewID() AS ID,
*
FROM 
(SELECT 
IIF(A.CustomerID='074','本厂采购','客户来纱') AS YarnCategory,
A.ReceSheetNo,
A.CustomerID,
A.ProdID,
A.LotNo,
A.InSheetKind,
A.ColorID,
A.PurchaseOrders,
A.FixedQty,
A.A_A,
A.A_B,
A.Packs-ISNULL(B.TPacks,0.00) AS Packs,
A.Rolls-ISNULL(B.TRolls,0.00)  AS Rolls,
A.LengthQty-ISNULL(B.TLengthQty,0.00)  AS LengthQty,
A.WeightQty-ISNULL(B.TWeightQty,0.00)  AS WeightQty
FROM dye.vwSemiStockBook_New A
LEFT JOIN (
SELECT 
ISNULL(Semi_Owner,'') AS CustomerID,
ISNULL(ProdID,'')ProdID,
ISNULL(LotNo,'')LotNo,
ISNULL(InSheetKind,'')InSheetKind,
ISNULL(ColorID,'')ColorID,
ISNULL(PurchaseOrders,'')PurchaseOrders,
ISNULL(FixedQty,0.0)FixedQty,
ISNULL(A_A,'')A_A,
ISNULL(A_B,'')A_B,
0 AS TPacks,
SUM(Rolls)TRolls,
0 AS TLengthQty,
SUM(Qty)AS TWeightQty
FROM dye.CarryMaterialDetail C
WHERE 1=1
AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.SemiOutDetail D WHERE D.JobSheetNo=C.JobSheetNo)
AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM dye.JobSheet J WHERE J.SheetNo=C.JobSheetNo)
GROUP BY Semi_Owner,ProdID,LotNo,InSheetKind,ColorID,PurchaseOrders,FixedQty,A_A,A_B
)B  ON 1=1
AND B.CustomerID = A.CustomerID 
AND B.ProdID = A.ProdID
AND B.LotNo = A.LotNo
AND B.InSheetKind = A.InSheetKind
AND B.ColorID = A.ColorID
AND B.PurchaseOrders = A.PurchaseOrders
AND B.FixedQty = A.FixedQty
AND B.A_A = A.A_A 
AND B.A_B = A.A_B 
)E 
WHERE 1=1
